close_reason: P4 / pedantic deduplication of hex_nibble_lower vs hex_nibble_upper. Two functions diverge by a single case-bit difference. Refactoring to a parameterized helper would not save a meaningful amount of code (4 lines max) and would obscure the per-function intent. Not worth the churn. Won't fix.
description: src/blob.rs:150-166 — two near-identical four-line functions differing only in the base byte (b'A' vs b'a'). Both contain an `unreachable!("nibble must be 0–15")` arm that pessimizes against a typo. Idiomatic alternatives: (a) single function `hex_nibble(n: u8, upper: bool) -> char`, (b) replace with `b"0123456789abcdef"[n as usize]` lookup (no unreachable, no match), (c) use the standard `format!("{:02x}")` / `{:02X}` pattern. The compute_sha256_hex impl already uses iter().fold() which is fine; just replace the helper with a simple table lookup. Note: locked crate.
title: hex_nibble_lower / hex_nibble_upper duplicate logic with case-bit difference
